Hello!

Thank you very much for the previous illustration of the kemo chibi gijinka version! It’s an amazing illustration. 

I would now like to request a full body illustration of the white eared fox girl mentioned in the previous request!

The character background for each character is below. 

The male kemo chibi fox, “Azarius Azariah Azure Flame,” is a man of few words who never complains, no matter how grueling the work or how difficult the situation. He tends to shut out his surroundings while working silently. He is a cursed being who, as divine punishment, was transformed into a chibi fox along with his superior. The two were banished from their original world and now wander as lost souls.
Before being cursed, Azarius was a low-ranking non-commissioned officer. Now, he has fallen to the role of a housekeeper for the Blue Ribbon Fox Girl, receiving leftovers as payment for his labor. His main duties include cleaning, cooking, and laundry. In addition to leftovers, he is provided with a place to sleep.
When he has stored enough energy, he can temporarily return to his original form. When that energy is depleted, he transforms into a ghost-like figure. He is skilled with firearms and possesses two revolvers from his original world; however, due to their weight, the Blue Ribbon Fox Girl usually carries them for him.

The female chibi fox, “Evelyn Everwhite Alabaster,” has a meddlesome and curious personality. She is Azarius’s direct superior and holds a higher military rank. Although that hierarchy may no longer truly matter, the two still regard each other as they did in their original world.
She enjoys invading the male chibi fox’s personal space to tease him. While she is polite to particularly strong opponents, she takes special pleasure in teasing him, as he always plays along with her antics. The male chibi fox is surprisingly eloquent, which greatly pleases her. Evelyn is skilled in whips.

Despite their distinct personalities, the curse leaves both Azarius and Evelyn prone to animalistic behaviors when in their chibi forms. Their fox instincts often override their discipline, making them easily tempted by tasty food and other simple pleasures. 

When they are finally reunited in another world, the male chibi fox is questioned about his employment as a housekeeper:

Female Chibi Fox: “I see… so you’ll follow any cute girl who gives you leftover scraps of bread?”

Male Chibi Fox: “…Hey, do you have any leftover scraps of bread?”

Female Chibi Fox: “!…Oh my, are you trying to indirectly call me cute to sway my heart? How presumptuous of you to say such a thing to your superior. Unfortunately, I’m not swayed. As a cute girl and your direct superior, you’d better watch your step. Otherwise, leftover sticks of wood will be waiting for you as punishment. Refusal is not permitted.”

Male Chibi Fox: “…If it’s from you, I suppose I don’t mind either.”

Female Chibi Fox: “!…My, what a dangerous thing to say to your superior…” “…Now I won’t let you go so easily.” She beams and wraps him in an overly tight, affectionate hug.

These two are lovers, and Evelyn is in charge of Azarius’s happiness.

Thank you very much for your time!
